name: Fujimuro Yusa
source:
She used to be a good wife and mother with a calm but gentle and cheerful personality, but her husband's unfaithfulness and domestic violence escalated, and when the protagonist took her in, she had become like a doll without feelings.

She had been mentally unstable for some time, but gradually recovers under the protagonist's devoted care.

[From [url=http://highseen.pink/gpower/product/dgp_pro23.html]official site[/url]]
